answer.summary: Generates the header for a printed ballot list report. It increments the page counter, prints a title line with program and date information, and prints a column header line for the transaction types (Booked, Rejected, Produced).

rules.text: Increment the page counter by 1 before printing the header.

Print the report title line to SYSPRINT with specific column positions: 'KARTENBANK  ABSTIMMLISTE' at col 2, S#KOPF_PGM at col 40, 'LAUF' at col 52, S#KOPF_DT at col 53, 'SEITE' at col 70, and S#SEITE at col 70 (formatted as F(4)).
Print the column header line to SYSPRINT with specific column positions: 'TYP' at col 2, S#TXT(1) at col 10, S#TXT(2) at col 43, and S#TXT(3) at col 76.
Set the line counter S#ZL to 4 after printing the header.
